coe:C06101.definition: Explicit, falsifiable proposition or decision conclusion an author asks the audience to accept—never a vague topic noun phrase.
coe:C06101.label: Toulmin Governing Claim

critical_questions: Is the claim stated as a complete, testable assertion rather than a neutral topic label?
Is the scope of the claim bounded to the personas and use cases actually supported by evidence?
payload.definition: Explicit, falsifiable proposition or decision conclusion an author asks the audience to accept—never a vague topic noun phrase.

coe:C06102.definition: Verifiable observations, architectural facts, latency measurements, or attributed customer metrics offered in direct support of a Governing Claim.
coe:C06102.label: Toulmin Empirical Grounds (Data)

critical_questions: Are the grounds drawn from an auditable source, benchmark, or documented product capability?
Are baseline, sample window, and measurement conditions stated alongside any percentage figure?
payload.definition: Verifiable observations, architectural facts, latency measurements, or attributed customer metrics offered in direct support of a Governing Claim.

coe:C06103.definition: Causal, architectural, or economic inference licence explaining *why* the Empirical Grounds justify the Governing Claim.
coe:C06103.label: Toulmin Warrant

critical_questions: Does the mechanism genuinely connect the cited product architecture to the claimed business outcome?
Would a sceptical CIO or CFO accept this link without unstated assumptions?
payload.definition: Causal, architectural, or economic inference licence explaining *why* the Empirical Grounds justify the Governing Claim.

coe:C06104.definition: Institutional standard, published specification, contractual term, or peer-reviewed body of evidence authenticating the Warrant itself.
coe:C06104.label: Toulmin Backing

critical_questions: Does authoritative documentation, open standard specification, or meta-analytic evidence back the warrant?
payload.definition: Institutional standard, published specification, contractual term, or peer-reviewed body of evidence authenticating the Warrant itself.

coe:C06105.definition: Explicit scope, edition, or probability calibration marker ('on eligible Firefly workflows', 'for sub-second edge lookups') preventing absolutist overclaiming.
coe:C06105.label: Toulmin Epistemic Qualifier

critical_questions: Have universal absolutes ('always', 'zero effort', '100% immune') been calibrated to honest scope conditions?
payload.definition: Explicit scope, edition, or probability calibration marker ('on eligible Firefly workflows', 'for sub-second edge lookups') preventing absolutist overclaiming.

coe:C06106.definition: Explicitly acknowledged counter-condition or trade-off under which the Governing Claim ceases to hold or requires an alternative pattern.
coe:C06106.label: Toulmin Rebuttal & Boundary Exception

critical_questions: Under what latency, licensing, or data-gravity boundary would an alternative architecture be superior?
Has the speaker addressed the strongest counter-argument candidly rather than attacking a strawman?
payload.definition: Explicitly acknowledged counter-condition or trade-off under which the Governing Claim ceases to hold or requires an alternative pattern.

coe:C06107.definition: Defeasible practical-reasoning scheme arguing for or against a course of action from its foreseeable operational, financial, and risk consequences.
coe:C06107.label: Walton Argument from Pragmatic Consequences

critical_questions: How strong is the causal likelihood that the proposed action produces the stated positive consequence?
What implementation costs, migration risks, or side effects accompany the action?
Are there simpler non-software process changes that achieve the same outcome?
payload.definition: Defeasible practical-reasoning scheme arguing for or against a course of action from its foreseeable operational, financial, and risk consequences.

coe:C06108.definition: Inference scheme reasoning from an observable architectural mechanism (such as edge profile caching or zero-copy SQL pushdown) to a measurable system behaviour.
coe:C06108.label: Walton Argument from Cause to Effect

critical_questions: Is the mechanism sufficient to produce the effect, or are prerequisite configurations required?
Could confounding factors (network egress, identity fragmentation) block the causal chain?
payload.definition: Inference scheme reasoning from an observable architectural mechanism (such as edge profile caching or zero-copy SQL pushdown) to a measurable system behaviour.
payload.pref_label: Walton Argument from Cause to Effect

coe:C06109.definition: Inference scheme illuminating an unfamiliar technical architecture by mapping its relational structure onto a familiar everyday or engineering system.
coe:C06109.label: Walton Argument from Structural Analogy

critical_questions: Do the source analogy and target system share deep causal relations rather than superficial labels?
Where does the analogy break down so novices do not form false mental models?
payload.definition: Inference scheme illuminating an unfamiliar technical architecture by mapping its relational structure onto a familiar everyday or engineering system.

coe:C06110.definition: Inference scheme grounding diagnosis in observable telemetry, audit logs, or live sandbox inspection rather than vendor assertion.
coe:C06110.label: Walton Argument from Verifiable Evidence & Sign

critical_questions: Is the observed indicator a reliable diagnostic sign of the underlying state?
Can the evaluator reproduce or inspect the sign directly in a live environment?
payload.definition: Inference scheme grounding diagnosis in observable telemetry, audit logs, or live sandbox inspection rather than vendor assertion.
payload.pref_label: Walton Argument from Verifiable Evidence & Sign

coe:C06111.definition: Kunz and Rittel dialogue-mapping scheme decomposing wicked architectural or governance trade-offs into explicit Issues, competing Positions, and supporting or objecting Arguments.
coe:C06111.label: IBIS Issue-Position-Argument Deliberation

critical_questions: Is the governing Issue framed as a genuine open design question rather than a disguised conclusion?
Are every viable competing Position and its strongest supporting and objecting Arguments represented symmetrically?
payload.definition: Kunz and Rittel dialogue-mapping scheme decomposing wicked architectural or governance trade-offs into explicit Issues, competing Positions, and supporting or objecting Arguments.

coe:C06112.definition: Defeasible appeal-to-authority scheme grounding an assertion in the documented judgement of a credentialled domain specialist or standards committee.
coe:C06112.label: Walton Argument from Expert Opinion

critical_questions: Is the cited authority genuinely credentialled inside the specific technical subfield at issue?
Is the expert assertion backed by reproducible primary evidence and aligned with broader peer consensus?
payload.definition: Defeasible appeal-to-authority scheme grounding an assertion in the documented judgement of a credentialled domain specialist or standards committee.

coe:C06113.definition: Defeasible scheme inferring prima facie viability of an architectural or operating pattern from widespread adoption across comparable peer organisations.
coe:C06113.label: Walton Argument from Popular Practice

critical_questions: Do the peer organisations share the same regulatory, latency, and data-gravity constraints as the target account?

payload.definition: Defeasible scheme inferring prima facie viability of an architectural or operating pattern from widespread adoption across comparable peer organisations.

coe:C06116.definition: Defeasible causal inference testing whether an observed co-movement between two metrics reflects genuine causal direction rather than a shared confounder or selection bias.

coe:C09501.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric auditing narrative tension, unit-sized assertion headlines, visual proof architecture, and honest claim discipline across executive briefings and technical evangelism decks.
coe:C09501.label: Executive Evangelism Slide Deck Rubric

criteria.definition: Evaluates whether the deck opens with concrete customer tension and a clear governing answer rather than vendor history or agenda bloat, and sustains a coherent causal storyline to a specific commitment.

levels.observable_descriptor: Opens with corporate credentials, product history, or generic agenda bullets; slides read as an unordered feature catalogue with no identifiable customer Complication or Governing Answer.
Names a customer problem eventually, but delays the core recommendation past the opening third of the deck or drifts into 'And-And-And' capability tours in the middle movement.
Establishes Situation, Complication, and Governing Answer within the opening three slides, sequences MECE proof pillars cleanly, and closes on a concrete, owner-assigned next step.
Hooks the target buyer persona's operational stakes on slide 1, sustains deliberate What-Is vs What-Could-Be contrast across every section pivot, and lands an unmistakable, defensible decision case.

criteria.definition: Evaluates whether content slide headlines state complete, falsifiable governing claims calibrated to each unit's level rather than vague topic nouns.

levels.observable_descriptor: Over half of content slides carry noun-phrase topic headers ('Data Architecture', 'Overview', 'Key Benefits') that state no testable conclusion.
Mixes declarative headlines with topic labels, or writes bloated three-line headlines packing multiple unrelated claims into one header.
At least 90% of proof slides state a concise, two-line maximum declarative assertion whose sequential reading reconstructs the entire talk's argument.
Every section and proof canvas states a crisp, active-verb governing thought sized precisely to its hierarchical level, making the horizontal storyline self-sufficient on a 30-second headline scan.

criteria.definition: Evaluates canvas proof quality, single-spark focal signalling, graphical integrity, WCAG luminance contrast, and elimination of competing bullet walls.

levels.observable_descriptor: Canvas bodies rely on multi-bullet text walls (>70 words), stock filler clichés, truncated chart baselines, low-contrast (<4.5:1) type, or rainbow accent clutter.
Includes diagrams or charts on some slides, but retains redundant sentence bullets alongside visuals, uses <28 px micro-labels, or relies on detached colour legends.
Proves claims visually via spatially contiguous diagrams, zero-based charts, or progressive builds; keeps on-slide word counts ≤45 words on proof slides and satisfies ≥4.5:1 AA contrast.

Every canvas pairs a clean neutral hierarchy with a single preattentive chromatic spark, ≥7:1 AAA body legibility, direct data/layer labelling, and speaker notes that carry the spoken elaboration without redundancy.

criteria.definition: Evaluates adherence to IP-indemnity, zero-copy latency, and edition- entitlement guardrails plus proactive inoculation of genuine trade-offs.

levels.observable_descriptor: Asserts prohibited legal, IP, latency, or edition overclaims, uses unbacked superlatives, or disparages competitors without verifiable architectural grounding.
Avoids hard legal violations, but glosses over edition boundaries (such as B2C vs B2B entitlements) or cites unanchored percentage lifts without baseline context.
States capabilities, edition scopes, and benchmark baselines accurately and complies with all applicable ClaimGuardrails.
Combines exact technical precision with proactive Inoculative Concession—candidly stating where warehouse federation vs edge profiles or partner integrations fit best to earn instant architect trust.

payload.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric auditing narrative tension, unit-sized assertion headlines, visual proof architecture, and honest claim discipline across executive briefings and technical evangelism decks.

coe:C09502.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric auditing ear-first syntax, global-L2 pacing, multimodal visual synchronisation, and phonetic/prosodic readiness in video and podcast narration scripts.
coe:C09502.label: Spoken Enablement Narration Script Rubric

criteria.definition: Evaluates whether sentences are written for single-pass listening with early finite verbs, natural oral rhythm, and zero nested parenthetical breath traps.

levels.observable_descriptor: Reads like pasted whitepaper prose: frequent >28-word sentences, centre-embedded clauses, parenthetical abbreviations, and zombie nominalisations that trip speakers on breath.
Mostly conversational, but leaves periodic multi-clause run-ons, passive agent deletions, or awkward written transitions ('moreover', 'aforementioned').
Maintains 10–19 word mean sentence length (hard cap ≤25 words), lands concrete subjects and active verbs early, and varies short pivot beats with medium explanatory sentences.
Reads effortlessly aloud on cold sight-read with unmistakable spoken cadence, crisp contrastive parallelism, and zero wasted syllables.

criteria.definition: Evaluates intentional boundary pauses, contrastive focus cues, and TTS/ presenter pronunciation guidance on acronyms and product names.

levels.observable_descriptor: Provides zero pronunciation guidance on ambiguous acronyms/terms (such as XDM, CJA, C2PA, LUFS) and packs paragraphs with no rhetorical pause markers before key reveals.
Expands some acronyms, but omits phonetic overrides for TTS/avatar pipelines or places pauses inconsistently.
Supplies explicit `spoken_form` / IPA guidance for every technical initialism and proper noun, and marks pre-reveal pauses and contrastive stress on key turns.
Integrates natural beat pauses, contrastive stress cues, and tested phonetic overrides seamlessly so both human presenters and neural TTS renders sound authoritative on the first take.

criteria.pref_label: Prosodic Cueing, Pause Architecture & Phonetic Overrides

criteria.definition: Evaluates how tightly spoken beats synchronise with visual state changes without reading on-screen text verbatim.

levels.observable_descriptor: Narration reads slide bullets word-for-word or runs >60 seconds over a static frozen visual with no state-change alignment.
Paraphrases slides partially, but visual build cues lag or precede their corresponding spoken nouns, causing split-attention search.
Complements concise visual labels with non-redundant causal voiceover and refreshes visual state every 15–38 seconds on clean beat boundaries.
Achieves tight temporal contiguity where every visual highlight or progressive diagram build fires on the exact spoken anchor phrase within a crisp ≤6-minute module budget.

criteria.definition: Evaluates idiom restraint, calibrated 122–145 WPM budget, psychological safety (zero patronising minimisers), and accurate product claims.

levels.observable_descriptor: Packs regional sports/slang idioms, patronising minimisers ('just', 'simply', 'obviously'), anthropomorphic AI hype, or >165 WPM word budgets into fixed runtime slots.
Eliminates blatant slang, but retains occasional LLM filler clichés or slightly over-packed word counts for global L2 listeners.
Uses clear international English calibrated to ~130–140 WPM, zero patronising minimisers, operational AI verbs, and verified product terminology.
Combines warm, peer-to-peer respect for global L2 practitioners with surgical technical precision and concrete customer workflow grounding.

payload.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric auditing ear-first syntax, global-L2 pacing, multimodal visual synchronisation, and phonetic/prosodic readiness in video and podcast narration scripts.

coe:C09503.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric auditing persona-anchored narrative framing, Value-Before-Click cursor discipline, cognitive-load pacing, and composure under live architectural Q&A.
coe:C09503.label: Live Technical Product Demonstration Rubric

criteria.definition: Evaluates whether the demo follows one coherent customer campaign or data scenario rather than an exhaustive menu-by-menu UI tour.

levels.observable_descriptor: Opens on generic admin homepages and tours navigation tabs left-to- right ('Here is Settings, here is Help') with no customer persona or business goal.
Mentions a customer scenario at the start, but detours into unrelated secondary features that dilute the core value path.
Follows a single named persona and end-to-end use case from trigger problem through key capability execution to verified business outcome.
Opens by showing the completed high-value outcome in 60 seconds ('Do the Last Thing First'), then unpacks only the 3–4 decisive architectural moments that made it possible.

criteria.definition: Evaluates whether the presenter orients viewer gaze and states *why* an action matters before moving the cursor or switching screens.

levels.observable_descriptor: Circles the mouse cursor compulsively while talking, clicks through dense unzoomed tables at 100% browser scale, and narrates raw mechanical clicks ('Now I click Save').
Zooms UI adequately, but clicks into new views simultaneously while explaining the previous screen, forcing viewers to chase screen refreshes.
Zooms browser UI to 125–150%, parks the cursor still when speaking, states the business intent first, executes the click cleanly, and pauses 1 second as the new view renders.
Directs attention effortlessly across every transition—naming the exact screen region, parking the pointer cleanly on the focal proof metric, and translating every UI result back to persona impact.

criteria.definition: Evaluates technical accuracy on data flow, governance, and edition boundaries during live evaluator questioning.

levels.observable_descriptor: Guesses or bluffs when challenged on latency, schema setup, or licensing; makes prohibited guardrail claims or dismisses valid architect concerns.
Answers basic product questions accurately, but gives long defensive answers on edge cases or blurs pre-staged demo shortcuts vs production configuration.
Distinguishes pre-configured demo state from real implementation effort transparently, answers architecture questions answer-first, and respects all edition/IP guardrails.

Welcomes tough CIO/architect pushback with calm terminal-fall composure, validates the underlying engineering concern, shows the live governance/lineage proof directly in UI, and logs any deep follow-up item precisely.

payload.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric auditing persona-anchored narrative framing, Value-Before-Click cursor discipline, cognitive-load pacing, and composure under live architectural Q&A.
payload.evaluated_artifact_kind: Live or Recorded Technical Product Demonstration

coe:C09504.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric scoring diagnostic questioning depth, multi-persona buying-group uncovering, commercial reframing, and evidence-backed objection resolution.
coe:C09504.label: Buyer Discovery & Objection Handling Roleplay Rubric

criteria.definition: Evaluates whether the candidate uncovers operational bottlenecks and quantifiable business impact before pitching product capabilities.

levels.observable_descriptor: Launches into a monologic product pitch within two turns without asking open discovery questions or confirming the buyer's priority problem.
Asks surface situational questions, but fails to probe downstream cost, cycle-time drag, or risk impact when the buyer drops a clue.
Uses layered open questions to surface current workflow breakdown, affected teams, and measurable business cost before proposing an approach.
Guides the buyer to quantify their own cost of inaction across speed, conversion, or risk, and summarises the agreed problem in the buyer's exact language before pivoting.

criteria.definition: Evaluates whether the candidate identifies technical evaluators, legal/ privacy stakeholders, and concrete evaluation yardsticks beyond a single champion.

levels.observable_descriptor: Treats a single conversational contact as sole decision maker and never asks about architecture, security, legal, or economic sign-off.
Asks generically 'Who else is involved?' without connecting adjacent stakeholders (CIO, CDO, Legal, Brand Studio) to their specific technical or governance concerns.
Identifies missing buying-committee roles, surfaces their distinct veto/decision criteria, and proposes concrete enablement artifacts for the champion to share.
Reframes evaluation criteria constructively so the champion sees why aligning IT/data and legal/governance early accelerates time-to- value rather than slowing the deal.

criteria.definition: Evaluates composure, empathetic validation of the root concern, and architectural precision when handling sceptical pushback.

levels.observable_descriptor: Argues defensively, interrupts the buyer, disparages the buyer's existing cloud warehouse/CRM investment, or makes an inaccurate overclaim to close the objection.
Stays polite, but responds with generic marketing talking points that miss the root architectural or legal anxiety beneath the objection.
Validates the underlying concern ('Zero-copy governance is the right standard'), explains the exact architectural division of labour accurately, and checks whether the response resolves the concern.
Turns the objection into a trust-building moment: acknowledges where the buyer's current stack excels, draws a crisp, guardrailed architectural boundary, and proposes a low-risk verification test.

payload.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric scoring diagnostic questioning depth, multi-persona buying-group uncovering, commercial reframing, and evidence-backed objection resolution.
payload.pref_label: Buyer Discovery & Objection Handling Roleplay Rubric

coe:C09505.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric auditing ISO 24495-1 answer-first structure, active-verb syntax, anti-AI-slop discipline, and accessibility/ claim compliance across written guides, briefs, and wiki syntheses.
coe:C09505.label: Plain-Language & Claim-Compliant Editorial Rubric

criteria.definition: Evaluates whether readers locate the governing answer within five seconds and navigate via specific, unit-sized headings.

levels.observable_descriptor: Buries the main conclusion beneath paragraphs of chronological backstory and uses opaque one-word headings ('Background', 'Notes', 'Misc').
States a purpose near the top, but mixes overlapping sections or leaves key operational actions hidden mid-paragraph.
Leads every document and major section with its governing answer or action and partitions sub-sections cleanly without overlap.
Enables both 15-second executive scanning via informative headings and deep practitioner execution without a single redundant bridging paragraph.

criteria.definition: Evaluates concrete actor-verb clarity, removal of Latinate noun bloat, and complete absence of stock LLM filler or patronising minimisers.

levels.observable_descriptor: Riddled with stock LLM clichés ('delve', 'tapestry', 'testament to', 'in today's landscape'), >15% agentless passives, or patronising 'simply/just' minimisers.
Free of obvious AI clichés, but leans on heavy `-tion/-ment` nominalisations ('perform an implementation of') or unquantified adjectives ('seamless', 'cutting-edge').
Keeps passive voice ≤8%, names concrete human or system actors, drives sentences with crisp finite verbs, and backs claims with specific mechanisms or figures.
Exhibits unmistakable human craft voice: economical, rhythmically varied, candid about boundary conditions, and completely free of corporate or synthetic puffery.

criteria.pref_label: Active Agent Syntax, De-Nominalisation & Zero AI Slop

criteria.definition: Evaluates exact official proper-noun naming, locale orthographic consistency, acronym expansion, and functional alt-text/link labels.

levels.observable_descriptor: Uses retired product names, mixes UK/US spelling randomly within the same paragraph, drops unexpanded internal acronyms, or leaves bare 'click here' links and missing alt-text.
Uses current product names mostly accurately, but occasionally alters trademarked US product spelling in UK prose or writes vague 'Chart of results' alt-text.

Honours canonical `pref_label` product names, maintains consistent target-locale prose spelling, expands acronyms on first mention for mixed cohorts, and supplies descriptive links and functional alt-text.
Every proper noun, edition qualifier, non-anthropomorphic AI verb, and accessible visual text-equivalent meets publication-grade audit with zero ambiguity.

payload.definition: Analytic 4-level CTDL-ASN rubric auditing ISO 24495-1 answer-first structure, active-verb syntax, anti-AI-slop discipline, and accessibility/ claim compliance across written guides, briefs, and wiki syntheses.
payload.evaluated_artifact_kind: Written Brief, Enablement Guide, or Technical Document

coe:C09601.definition: Detects slide headlines, section titles, or opening paragraphs that announce a neutral subject category ('Architecture Overview', 'Journey Orchestration') or delay the governing conclusion behind chronological throat-clearing.
coe:C09601.label: Topic-Label Headline & Buried Lead Detector

payload.definition: Detects slide headlines, section titles, or opening paragraphs that announce a neutral subject category ('Architecture Overview', 'Journey Orchestration') or delay the governing conclusion behind chronological throat-clearing.
payload.detection_signal_description: Proof-slide or section title lacks a finite verb or comparative predicate (pure noun phrase ≤4 words on a non-divider unit), or the opening paragraph of a brief spends >2 sentences on process history before stating a recommendation or decision takeaway.
payload.remediation_instruction: Rewrite the headline as a complete, falsifiable declarative sentence (≤2 lines) stating *what* happens and *why it matters* at this unit's level, and hoist the bottom-line recommendation into sentence 1 of the section.

coe:C09602.definition: Detects stock LLM filler lexicon, formulaic contrastive boilerplate, and unquantified marketing superlatives that erode executive and technical credibility.
coe:C09602.label: AI Cliché & Empty Superlative Detector

payload.definition: Detects stock LLM filler lexicon, formulaic contrastive boilerplate, and unquantified marketing superlatives that erode executive and technical credibility.
payload.detection_signal_description: Presence of high-salience synthetic clichés ('delve', 'rich tapestry', 'testament to', 'in today's rapidly evolving landscape', 'unlock the full potential', 'seamless synergy', repetitive 'It's not just X—it's Y' frames) or unbacked intensifiers ('blazingly fast', 'infinite scale', 'turnkey magic', 'revolutionary') without adjacent mechanism or metric grounds.
payload.remediation_instruction: Delete synthetic throat-clearing outright and replace every superlative adjective with the concrete architectural mechanism, contractual scope, or baseline-anchored figure that earns the claim.

coe:C09603.definition: Detects concentrations of short/agentless passive clauses ('data is ingested, segments are built, and offers are delivered') that obscure whether a customer team, an Adobe service, or an automated agent executes the work.
coe:C09603.label: Agentless Passive Voice Cluster Detector

payload.definition: Detects concentrations of short/agentless passive clauses ('data is ingested, segments are built, and offers are delivered') that obscure whether a customer team, an Adobe service, or an automated agent executes the work.
payload.detection_signal_description: Finite-clause passive share exceeds 14% across a document/script or two or more consecutive clauses omit `by <actor>` in procedural, architectural, or governance explanations.
payload.remediation_instruction: Name the exact responsible actor ('Data engineers map...', 'Identity Service stitches...', 'Legal stewards approve...') in grammatical subject position and convert the passive participle into an active finite verb.

coe:C09604.definition: Detects abstract `-tion`, `-ment`, `-ance`, and `-isation` noun clusters paired with semantically empty light verbs ('conduct an evaluation of', 'enable the facilitation of', 'achieve the optimisation of').
coe:C09604.label: Zombie Nominalisation Drag Detector

payload.definition: Detects abstract `-tion`, `-ment`, `-ance`, and `-isation` noun clusters paired with semantically empty light verbs ('conduct an evaluation of', 'enable the facilitation of', 'achieve the optimisation of').
payload.detection_signal_description: Light-verb + determiner + deverbal-noun + `of` constructions (`make/do/ perform/conduct/provide/enable + a/the + <nominalisation> + of`) where the noun is not a canonical proper-noun `ProductCapability` or `TechnicalStandard`.
payload.remediation_instruction: Collapse the light-verb construction directly into its root active verb ('evaluate', 'facilitate', 'optimise', 'query') and tighten surrounding prepositional chains.

coe:C09605.definition: Detects difficulty-minimising adverbs ('simply', 'just', 'obviously', 'trivial') and opaque local idioms ('hit it out of the park', 'boil the ocean', 'move the goalposts') that alienate learners and global L2 audiences.
coe:C09605.label: Patronising Minimiser & Idiom Barrier Detector

payload.definition: Detects difficulty-minimising adverbs ('simply', 'just', 'obviously', 'trivial') and opaque local idioms ('hit it out of the park', 'boil the ocean', 'move the goalposts') that alienate learners and global L2 audiences.
payload.detection_signal_description: Occurrence of difficulty minimisers (`simply`, `just`, `merely`, `obviously`, `clearly`, `easily`, `self-evident`) inside procedural or conceptual explanations, or culture-bound sports/military idioms in `global_l2_inclusive` materials.
payload.remediation_instruction: Delete difficulty minimisers cleanly and replace culture-specific idioms with literal, internationally transparent operational verbs.

coe:C09606.definition: Detects talk tracks, video scripts, and decks that squander the opening 30–60 seconds on housekeeping, generic housekeeping agendas, self-indulgent bios, or truisms ('Data is everywhere today') before establishing stakes.
coe:C09606.label: Throat-Clearing Opening & Agenda Bloat Detector

payload.definition: Detects talk tracks, video scripts, and decks that squander the opening 30–60 seconds on housekeeping, generic housekeeping agendas, self-indulgent bios, or truisms ('Data is everywhere today') before establishing stakes.
payload.detection_signal_description: Opening 100 spoken words or first two content slides contain meta-agenda recitation ('Today we're going to cover five topics...'), housekeeping apologies ('Can everyone see my screen?'), or category truisms with zero persona-specific Complication or tension metric.
payload.remediation_instruction: Cut housekeeping and generic truisms; open cold on the concrete customer failure moment, surprising empirical contrast, or decision question that justifies the audience's time, then signpost structure in one crisp sentence.

coe:C09607.definition: Detects spoken script sentences containing >25 words, centre-embedded relative clauses separating subject from verb by >7 words, or parenthetical asides/acronyms unreadable aloud.
coe:C09607.label: Spoken Breath-Trap & Nested Clause Detector

payload.definition: Detects spoken script sentences containing >25 words, centre-embedded relative clauses separating subject from verb by >7 words, or parenthetical asides/acronyms unreadable aloud.
payload.detection_signal_description: Spoken narration sentence exceeds 25 words, inserts a comma-bounded or parenthetical clause between grammatical subject and finite verb, or leaves symbolic shorthand (`e.g.`, `i.e.`, `/`, `&`, raw all-caps acronyms without `spoken_form`) in spoken transcript fields.
payload.remediation_instruction: Break into two linear active sentences of 10–18 words each, keep subject and verb adjacent, replace Latin/slash shorthand with spoken words ('for example', 'that is', 'and'), and attach phonetic overrides where needed.

coe:C09608.definition: Detects projected or narrated slides where multi-bullet sentence lists, >70 on-canvas words, or competing chromatic callouts violate Dual Coding and induce Mayer Redundancy interference.
coe:C09608.label: Wall-of-Bullets Slide Overload Detector

payload.definition: Detects projected or narrated slides where multi-bullet sentence lists, >70 on-canvas words, or competing chromatic callouts violate Dual Coding and induce Mayer Redundancy interference.
payload.detection_signal_description: Live presentation or video slide contains ≥4 full-sentence bullets, >70 visible canvas words, <22% open canvas whitespace, or >2 competing high- saturation highlight colours on non-categorical elements.
payload.remediation_instruction: Move full-sentence explanation into presenter notes/voiceover, distil the slide header into one declarative assertion, and convert the canvas body into a spatial diagram, contrasting topology pair, or progressive stepwise build with a single focal accent colour.
